title: NextLongIso samplesheet
description: Schema for the file provided with --samplesheet. Columns: sample,condition and either fastq (--input_type fastq) or bam (--input_type bam).

sample.errorMessage: Sample names are required, must be unique, must start with a letter and may contain only letters, digits and underscores (regex ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$). Characters such as '.' or '-' are not allowed because R and DESeq2 rewrite such names, which breaks the matching between count tables and the samplesheet.

condition.errorMessage: Condition is required for every sample, must start with a letter and may contain only letters, digits and underscores (regex ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$). Characters such as '.' or '-' are not allowed because R and DESeq2 rewrite such names.

fastq.errorMessage: FASTQ file must exist, must not contain spaces and must end with .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz or .fq.gz

bam.errorMessage: BAM file must exist, must not contain spaces and must end with .bam
